text:
Predicates:
FromIstanbul(x) ::: x's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
PlateNumber(x, y) ::: x's license plate begins with number y.
Joe(x) ::: x is Joe.
Tom(x) ::: x is Tom.
BeginWith(x, y) ::: x's license plate begins with number y.
Premises:
∀x (PlateNumber(x, 34) → FromIstanbul(x)) ::: All plates beginning with 34 are from Istanbul.
∀x (¬PlateNumber(x, 34) → ¬FromIstanbul(x)) ::: Plates not beginning with 34 are not from Istanbul.
FromIstanbul(Joe) ::: Joe's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginWith(Tom, 35) ::: Tom's license plate begins with 35.
∀x (BeginWith(x, 35) → ¬BeginWith(x, 34)) ::: If a plate begins with 35, then it does not begin with 34.
Conclusion:
FromIstanbul(Tom) ::: Tom's license plate is from Istanbul.
